titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Zadok Faints; Solomon Pursues the Ethiopians (ch. 57–58)
part: ch. 57–58 — Zadok Faints; Solomon Pursues the Ethiopians
about: Zadok falls as if dead on seeing that Zion is gone, and his cry brings the king, who commands a pursuit and vows death to the thieves. Solomon sets out in anger as Israel weeps; his messengers learn in Egypt and at Gaza that the Ethiopians passed days ago in flying chariots, and nothing was seen of Zion.

sentences.t: ፶፯ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ውድቀተ ፡ ሳዶቅ ፡ ካህን ።
sentences.l: 57. Concerning the fall of Zadok the priest
sentences.i: Chapter 57: Concerning the Fall of Zadok the Priest
sentences.n: Chapter heading. በእንተ 'concerning' + construct ውድቀተ (verbal noun of ወደቀ 'fall', 'fall-of') ሳዶቅ ካህን 'Zadok priest' (noun in apposition). Note the spelling ሳዶቅ here, where the preceding part and the body of this chapter write ሰዶቅ; kept as printed.

sentences.t: ወርእዮ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ወድቀ ፡ በገጹ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወተክዕወት ፡ ነፍሱ ፡ በላዕሌሁ ፡ እስመ ፡ ደንገፀ ፡ ወኮነ ፡ ከመ ፡ በድን ፤
sentences.l: And-seeing this, fell on-his-face to-ground, and-was-poured-out his-soul upon-him, for he-was-terrified, and-became like corpse;
sentences.i: When he saw this, he fell on his face to the ground, and his spirit was poured out within him, for he was struck with terror and became like a corpse;
sentences.n: ወርእዮ 'and seeing' (ወ- + infinitive ርእዮ of ርእየ, used as a circumstantial clause); ዘንተ 'this' (accusative of ዝንቱ). ወድቀ 'he fell' (3ms perfect), በገጹ 'on his face' (በ- + ገጽ + ሁ). ወተክዕወት ነፍሱ በላዕሌሁ: ተክዕወ is the passive/reflexive of a root meaning 'pour out' (?); 'his soul was poured out upon/within him' is a literal reading, and the sense is that he swooned (?). ደንገፀ 'was terrified' (perfect). ከመ በድን 'like a corpse' (በድን 'dead body').

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ጐንደየ ፡ ወፂአ ፡ ለአከ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ኢዮአስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዮዳሔ ፡ ወረከቦ ፡ ውዱቀ ፡ ከመ ፡ በድን ፡ ወአንሥኦ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ ወገሰሶ ፡ ልቦ ፡ ወአንፎ ፡ እመ ፡ ይረክብ ፡ ምዉቀ ፡ እስትንፋስ ፡ በላዕሌሁ ፡ ወነፍሖ ፡ ወአንሥኦ ፡ ወነገፎ ፡ ወአፅግዖ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጠረጲዛ ፡ ወተንሥአ ፡ ወነጸረ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምንባሪሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወኢረከባ ፤
sentences.l: And-when he-lingered to-come-out, sent to-him Joash (ኢዮአስ) son-of Jehoiada, and-found-him fallen like corpse, and-raised-him, his-head, and-felt his-heart, and-put-to-nose [?] if he-find a-sign (?) of-breath in-him, and-blew-on-him, and-raised-him, and-shook-him, and-set-him (?) by table; and-rose, and-looked toward her-seat, of-Zion, and-did-not-find-her;
sentences.i: And when he delayed in coming out, the king sent Joash son of Jehoiada to him, and he found him lying like a corpse; he lifted his head, felt his heart, and held his hand to his nose (?) to see whether he could find breath in him; he breathed on him, raised him, shook him, and set him (?) by the table. Then Zadok rose and looked toward the seat of Zion, and did not find her;
sentences.n: Unit of 34 words, cut at the ፤. ወሶበ ጐንደየ ወፂአ 'and when he lingered (ጐንደየ, perfect) to come out' (ወፂአ infinitive of ወፅአ, 'coming out'). ለአከ ሎቱ 'sent to him': the sender is the king, never named (?). ኢዮአስ ወልደ ዮዳሔ is printed so (Joash son of Jehoiada); the names are kept as printed, and the pairing is borrowed from 2 Kings 11–12, which is far later than Solomon's time. The run of ወ-verbs (ወረከቦ 'and found him', ወአንሥኦ 'and raised him', ወገሰሶ 'and felt', ወነፍሖ 'and blew on him', ወነገፎ 'and shook him') uses the suffix -o 'him' on each; ርእሶ and ልቦ are accusatives with 'his'. ወአንፎ 'put to the nose' is uncertain (?) (from አንፍ 'nose'). እመ ይረክብ 'in case he might find', ምዉቀ እስትንፋስ is UNCERTAIN: ምዉቅ normally means 'known', so 'a known (sign of) breath' (?) is only a guess. ወአፅግዖ ውስተ ጠረጲዛ 'and (?) him to the table' is uncertain in the verb: 'set him against / lean him on the table' is a guess. The subject then shifts without notice: ወተንሥአ ወነጸረ 'and he rose and looked' is Zadok. ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'her seat, of Zion' (suffix anticipating the genitive).

sentences.t: ወወድቀ ፡ ወወደየ ፡ ሐመደ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ርእሱ ፡ ወተንሥአ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ወከልሐ ፡ በአናቅጺሃ ፡ ለቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-fell, and-put ashes on his-head, and-rose, and-went, and-cried-out at-her-doors, of-house-of God;
sentences.i: He fell down again and put ashes on his head, and he rose and went and cried out at the doors of the house of God;
sentences.n: ወወድቀ 'and he fell' (ወ- + perfect ወድቀ). ሐመደ 'ashes' (accusative), the sign of mourning. ወከልሐ 'and he cried out' (perfect). በአናቅጺሃ ለቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'at its doors, of the house of God': the suffix ሃ 'its/her' anticipates the genitive ለ-phrase, as in ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን. አናቅጽ 'doors' is a plural. እግዚኣብሔር is the printed spelling.

sentences.t: ወተሰምዐ ፡ ድምፅ ፡ እስከ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ንጉሥ ።
sentences.l: And-was-heard a-sound as-far-as house-of king.
sentences.i: And the sound was heard as far as the king's house.
sentences.n: ወተሰምዐ 'and was heard' (passive-reflexive ተሰምዐ, 3ms). ድምፅ 'sound, voice'. እስከ 'as far as, until'. ቤተ ንጉሥ 'house-of king' (construct): the palace.

sentences.t: ወተንሥአ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወአዘዘ ፡ ይዑዱ ፡ ዐዋዲ ፡ ወይንፍሑ ፡ ቀርነ ፡ ፀባኢት ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሖሩ ፡ ወይስድድዎ ፡ ለሰብአ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወለእመ ፡ ረከቦሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ የአኀዞ ፡ ለወልዱ ፡ ወያግብኦ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ወይቅትሎሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ በአፈ ፡ ኀጺን ፤
sentences.l: And-rose king, and-ordered that-circulate (?) heralds and-blow horn-of battle, that-they-go and-pursue-them, the-men-of land-of Ethiopia; and-if he-find (?) them, that-they-seize him, his-son, and-bring-back-him with Zion, and-kill-them, all-of-them, with-mouth-of iron;
sentences.i: The king rose and commanded that heralds should go about (?) and blow the horn of war, so that they might go out and pursue the men of the land of Ethiopia; and if they found them, they were to seize his son and bring him back with Zion, and to kill all the rest by the edge of the sword;
sentences.n: Unit of 26 words. አዘዘ 'he commanded', followed by the subjunctives ይዑዱ … ወይንፍሑ 'that they … and blow' (the subjunctive without ከመ after a verb of command). ይዑዱ ዐዋዲ is UNCERTAIN: ዐዋዲ may be 'heralds, criers' (?) and ይዑዱ some verb of going round or proclaiming (?). ቀርነ ፀባኢት 'horn-of war' (construct; ፀባኢት 'war, host'). ከመ ይሖሩ ወይስድድዎ 'that they go and pursue them' (ሰደደ 'pursue, drive'; -ዎ is the 3mp object after -u). ለእመ 'if'; ረከቦሙ 'he found them' (or 'they found them'). The object of የአኀዞ ለወልዱ 'that they seize him, his son' is doubled (-ዎ … ለወልዱ), and 'his son' is Menelik, Solomon's son by the Queen of Sheba. በአፈ ኀጺን 'with the mouth-of iron' is Hebrew-style 'edge of the sword'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ በአፉሁ ፡ ነበበ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ሕያው ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ሞት ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ወኢኮኑ ፡ ለሕይወት ፡ እስመ ፡ በአማን ፡ ይደልዎሙ ፡ ሞት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘሰረቁ ፡ ቤተ ፡ መቅደሱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወፈቀዱ ፡ ያርኵሱ ፡ ማኅደረ ፡ ስሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ዘአልቦ ፡ ሕገ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: For with-his-mouth he-spoke and-said: Living (is) God, God-of Israel, that men-of death (are) they and-not for-life; for in-truth is-due-to-them death, because-of that-which they-stole house-of his-sanctuary, of-God, and-wished that-they-defile dwelling-of his-name in-land which-not-is law. * * * * * * * *
sentences.i: For with his own mouth he had spoken and said: 'As the Lord lives, the God of Israel, these are men of death and not of life; for in truth death is their due, because they have stolen the house of the sanctuary of God and have wished to defile the dwelling of His name in a land that has no law.'
sentences.n: እስመ 'for'. በአፉሁ 'with his mouth' (አፍ + ሁ). ሕያው እግዚኣብሔር 'living is God' is the oath formula 'as the Lord lives' (compare 1 Samuel 14:39), here with አምላከ እስራኤል in apposition (construct). ሰብአ ሞት 'men-of death'; ኢኮኑ ለሕይወት 'they are not for life' (ኮነ 'be' negated). ይደልዎሙ ሞት 'death befits them' (ደለወ 'be fitting, due', object -ሙ). በእንተ ዘሰረቁ 'because of that which they stole'. ቤተ መቅደሱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the house of his sanctuary, of God', and ማኅደረ ስሙ 'dwelling-of his name' (Deuteronomy 12:11 style; the 'name' dwelling is the Zion theology). ዘአልቦ ሕገ 'which has no law' (አልቦ 'there is not' + accusative ሕገ). Eight ፨ close the chapter, kept on this last unit.

sentences.t: ፶፰ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተንሥአ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ይቅትሎሙ ።
sentences.l: 58. Where rose Solomon to-kill-them.
sentences.i: Chapter 58: How Solomon Rose to Kill Them
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ here opens a relative clause, 'where / (the place) to which', as the heading to the next scene; the sense is 'how / when Solomon arose' (?). ተንሥአ 'rose', ይቅትሎሙ 'that he kill them' (subjunctive, object -ሙ). ሰሎሞን Solomon.

sentences.t: ከመዝ ፡ ተናገረ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወተንሥአ ፡ በመዐት ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኅሥሦሙ ፤
sentences.l: Thus spoke king Solomon, and-rose in-wrath and-went that-he-seek-them;
sentences.i: So spoke King Solomon; and he rose in anger and went out to seek them;
sentences.n: ከመዝ 'thus' (ከመ + ዝ). ተናገረ 'spoke'. በመዐት 'in wrath' (በ- 'in'). ከመ ይኅሥሦሙ 'that he seek them' (ኀሠሠ 'seek', subjunctive with object -ሙ).

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ተንሥኡ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወመኳንንቲሁ ፡ ወኀያላኒሁ ፡ ተጋብኡ ፡ አእሩገ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ምስለ ፡ አቤራት ፡ ወደናግል ፡ ወበከዩ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ እስመ ፡ ተነሥአት ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ።
sentences.l: And-when rose king and-his-nobles and-his-mighty-ones, gathered elders-of Israel in house-of God with widows (?) and-virgins, and-wept for Zion, for was-taken-away from-among-them ark-of the-law of-God.
sentences.i: And when the king and his nobles and his warriors had risen, the elders of Israel gathered in the house of God, with widows (?) and maidens, and wept for Zion, because the Ark of the Law of God had been taken from among them.
sentences.n: ወሶበ 'and when' + perfect. መኳንንቲሁ 'his nobles' and ኀያላኒሁ 'his mighty ones' (plurals with ሁ 'his'). ተጋብኡ 'gathered' (reflexive). አእሩገ እስራኤል 'elders-of Israel' (construct). አቤራት is UNCERTAIN (?): read as a plural meaning 'widows' on the strength of the pairing with ደናግል 'virgins'. ወበከዩ 'and they wept'. እስመ ተነሥአት 'for was taken away / lifted' (feminine passive, agreeing with ታቦት). እምኔሆሙ 'from among them'. ታቦተ ሕጉ 'ark-of his law' is printed with the accusative ending -ተ even though it is the subject of the passive ተነሥአት (?); the passive can keep the accusative of the thing taken. ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'his law, of God'.

sentences.t: ወለሰዶቅኒ ፡ እስመ ፡ ገብአ ፡ ልቡ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ጒንዱይ ፡ ሰዐት ።
sentences.l: And-as-for-Zadok — for returned his-heart after the-lingering of-an-hour (?).
sentences.i: And as for Zadok, his heart returned to him after a lingering of an hour (?).
sentences.n: ወለሰዶቅኒ 'and as for Zadok too' (ለ- 'as for' + ኒ 'also, indeed'), the name spelled ሰዶቅ again. እስመ ገብአ ልቡ 'for his heart returned' (the idiom for coming to oneself). ጒንዱይ 'lingering, delay' (a noun from the verb ጐንደየ seen in the previous chapter) is read here as the time he lay senseless: 'after an hour's swoon' is the meaning (?). ሰዐት 'hour'.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሖሩ ፡ ይምነ ፡ ወፅግመ ፡ ከመ ፡ እመቦ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትገሐሡ ፡ እምፍርሀተ ፡ ስርቅ ፤
sentences.l: And-then ordered king that-they-go right and-left, that-if there-is (anyone), that-they-(?) from-fear-of theft;
sentences.i: Then the king commanded that they should go to the right and to the left, so that if there were any, they might hurry (?) for fear of the theft;
sentences.n: CRUX. ወእምዝ 'and after this'. ይሖሩ ይምነ ወፅግመ 'that they go right and left' (ይምነ 'to the right', ፅግም 'left'). The rest, ከመ እመቦ ከመ ይትገሐሡ እምፍርሀተ ስርቅ, is hard: እመቦ 'if there is (any)', then a second ከመ and ይትገሐሡ, which I take as from a verb of moving or hastening (?) (perhaps related to ገሠሠ 'go about, search' (?)). 'For fear of theft' (እምፍርሀተ ስርቅ, 'from the fear-of theft') could mean either the pursuers' fear or the fugitives'. The rendering is a guess; the text may be corrupt.

sentences.t: ወለሊሁሰ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ተንሥአ ፡ በአሠረ ፡ ፍኖቶሙ ፡ ለሰብአ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወፈነወ ፡ መባርዲን ፤
sentences.l: And-himself indeed, king, rose in-track-of their-way, of-men-of Ethiopia, and-sent couriers (?);
sentences.i: And the king himself rose to follow the trail of the Ethiopians' road, and he sent out couriers (?),
sentences.n: ወለሊሁሰ 'and as for him himself' (ለሊሁ 'himself' + ሰ, the contrastive particle: the king, as against the others he had sent). በአሠረ ፍኖቶሙ 'in the track-of their road' (አሠር 'track, footprint'). መባርዲን 'couriers' (?) is an uncertain word; it looks like a plural of a foreign loan (compare Arabic barīd 'post, courier') (?). The ፤ falls before the apposition ሰብአ አፍራስ in the next unit.

sentences.t: ሰብአ ፡ አፍራስ ፤
sentences.l: men-of horses;
sentences.i: horsemen,
sentences.n: ሰብአ አፍራስ 'men-of horses' (construct, አፍራስ plural of ፈረስ 'horse'), explaining the couriers.

sentences.t: ከመ ፡ ያእምሩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሀለዉ ፡ ወይግብኡ ፡ ወይንግርዎ ።
sentences.l: that-they-learn where they-are, and-return, and-tell-him.
sentences.i: that they might learn where they were, and come back and tell him.
sentences.n: ከመ ያእምሩ 'that they know/learn' (subjunctive of አእመረ, causative of ዐወቀ 'know'). ኀበ ሀለዉ 'where they were' (ሀለወ 'be, exist'). ወይግብኡ ወይንግርዎ 'and return and tell him' (subjunctives; -ዎ 'him').

sentences.t: ወሖሩ ፡ ወበጽሑ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ምስር ፡ ኀበ ፡ ተዐየኑ ፡ ህየ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንጉሦሙ ፡ ወኀበሂ ፡ ተሰለምዋ ፡ ለጽዮን ፤
sentences.l: And-they-went and-reached city-of Egypt (ምስር), where they-were-seen there men-of Ethiopia with their-king, and-where-also they-greeted (?) Zion;
sentences.i: And they went and reached the city of Egypt, where the men of Ethiopia had been seen with their king, and where they had also saluted (?) Zion;
sentences.n: ምስር 'Egypt'. ሀገረ ምስር 'city-of Egypt' (construct). ኀበ 'where'. ተዐየኑ 'were seen / met face to face' (reflexive of ዐየነ 'look at'; the exact sense is uncertain (?)). ህየ 'there'. ንጉሦሙ 'their king' (ንጉሥ + ሙ). ወኀበሂ 'and where also' (ኀበ + ሂ). ተሰለምዋ ለጽዮን 'they greeted/saluted her, Zion' (? from ሰላም; reflexive ተሰለመ is rare (?)), with -ዋ 'her' resumed by ለጽዮን.

sentences.t: ወተፈሥሑ ፡ ወሐተቱ ፡ ኪያሆሙ ፡ ሐራ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ብሔረ ፡ ግብጽ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-rejoiced, and-questioned them, soldiers-of king, and-said-to-them men-of land-of Egypt;
sentences.i: And they rejoiced, and the king's soldiers questioned them, and the men of the land of Egypt said to them,
sentences.n: ተፈሥሑ 'they rejoiced'; the subject is not stated and may be the soldiers or the Egyptians (?). ሐተቱ 'they questioned' (ሐተተ 'inquire'), ኪያሆሙ 'them' (the independent object pronoun). ሐራ ንጉሥ 'host-of king'. ወይቤልዎሙ 'and they said to them' (ይቤ + -ል- 'to' + -ዎሙ; the ል- before suffix marks dative). The speech runs on through unit 19.

sentences.t: እምርሑቅ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ በዝየ ፡ ኀለፉ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይረውጹ ፡ በሰረገላ ፡ ከመ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወይቀልሉ ፡ እምነ ፡ አንስርት ፡ በውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፤
sentences.l: From-distant days, here passed men-of Ethiopia, while-they-run in-chariot like angels, and-they-are-swift than eagles in-midst-of sky;
sentences.i: Long ago the men of Ethiopia passed here, speeding along in a chariot like angels, and swifter than the eagles in the sky;
sentences.n: እምርሑቅ መዋዕል 'from distant days' (መዋዕል 'days', plural). በዝየ 'here'. እንዘ ይረውጹ 'while they run' (እንዘ + imperfect = circumstantial). በሰረገላ 'in a chariot'. ከመ መላእክት 'like angels'. ይቀልሉ እምነ አንስርት 'they are lighter/swifter than eagles' (comparative with እምነ 'than'; አንስርት plural of ንሥር). በውስተ ሰማይ 'in the sky'.

sentences.t: ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ ማእዜ ፡ ዕለት ፡ ኀለፉ ፡ እምኔክ ፡ ሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-said-to-them: When day did-they-pass from-you (ሙ)?
sentences.i: and they said to them, 'On what day did they pass by you?'
sentences.n: ወይቤልዎሙ 'and they (Solomon's men) said to them'. ማእዜ 'when?' followed by ዕለት 'day'. ኀለፉ 'they passed'. እምኔክ ፡ ሙ: the printed text separates the last syllable of እምኔክሙ 'from you (pl.)' as a word of its own; kept as printed, the sense is unchanged.

sentences.t: ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ ዮም ፡ ተሱዕ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ በዘ ፡ ኀለፉ ፡ እምኔነ ።
sentences.l: And-said-to-them: Today (is) nine days since they-passed from-us.
sentences.i: And they said to them, 'Today it is nine days since they passed from us.'
sentences.n: ወይቤልዎሙ 'and they said to them' (the Egyptians). ዮም 'today'. ተሱዕ መዋዕል 'nine days'. በዘ ኀለፉ 'since (in that) they passed' (በ- + ዘ- 'in that which'). እምኔነ 'from us'.

sentences.t: ወቦ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ገብኡ ፡ ወነገርዎ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ከመ ፡ ኀለፉ ፡ ተሱዐ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ እምዘ ፡ ኀለፉ ፡ እምስር ፤
sentences.l: And-there-were among-them who returned, and-told-him to-king Solomon that they-passed nine days since they-passed from-Egypt (እምስር);
sentences.i: And some of them came back and told King Solomon that nine days had passed since they went by from Egypt;
sentences.n: ወቦ 'and there is/was' (ቦ 'there is' + ወ-). እለ ገብኡ 'who returned' (እለ relative plural). ወነገርዎ ለንጉሥ 'and told him, namely the king'. ከመ 'that' (introducing indirect speech). ተሱዐ መዋዕል 'nine days' in the accusative. እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed'. እምስር: the printed form lacks the ም of ምስር (a probable slip, 'Egypt'); kept as printed.

sentences.t: ወአብያጺነሰ ፡ ሖሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይኅሥሡ ፡ እስከ ፡ ባሕረ ፡ ኢርትራ ፡ ወንሕነሰ ፡ ገባእነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ንንግርከ ፡ ዘንተ ፤
sentences.l: And-our-companions (?) indeed went that-they-seek as-far-as sea-of Erythrea, and-we indeed returned that-we-tell-you this;
sentences.i: And as for our companions (?), they went on to search as far as the Red Sea, while we on our side came back to tell you this.
sentences.n: The form ወአብያጺነሰ is printed so and kept; it is UNCERTAIN: it looks like a plural noun with ነ 'our' and the contrastive ሰ, and I take it as 'our companions' (?). The pair -ሰ … -ሰ (ወአብያጺነሰ … ወንሕነሰ) sets 'they' against 'we'. ከመ ይኅሥሡ 'that they search'. ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'sea-of Erythra', the Greek name for the Red Sea (Erythra Thalassa). ንሕነ 'we', ገባእነ 'we returned', ከመ ንንግርከ ዘንተ 'that we tell you this' (-ከ 'you').

sentences.t: እስኩ ፡ ኀሊ ፡ ለሊከ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ሰኑይ ፡ እምከመ ፡ ወፅኡ ፡ እምኀቤከ ፡ በጽሑ ፡ በሠሉስ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፈለገ ፡ ተከዚ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ምስር ፤
sentences.l: Come, consider yourself, O king: on day-of Monday after they-went-out from-you, they-arrived on Tuesday at river-of Takkazē, city-of Egypt;
sentences.i: Come, consider it yourself, O king: on Monday, after they left you, they reached on the Tuesday the river Tekezé, in the land of Egypt;
sentences.n: እስኩ 'come now' (an exhortative particle), ኀሊ 'consider' (imperative of ኀለየ), ለሊከ 'yourself'. ንጉሥ 'O king' (vocative). በዕለተ ሰኑይ 'on the day-of Monday', and ሠሉስ 'Tuesday' (the 'third' day). እምከመ ወፅኡ 'after they went out'. ኀበ ፈለገ ተከዚ 'at the river Takkazē': the Takkazē is the great river of northern Ethiopia, which sits oddly beside ሀገረ ምስር 'city of Egypt'. Either the text is confused or the 'Egypt' is generous (?); kept as printed.

sentences.t: ወለነኒ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ፈነውከነ ፡ እምኢየሩሳሌም ፡ በጻሕነ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ሰንበት ፡ ወገባእነ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡ ዮምበዕለተ ፡ ራብዕ ፤
sentences.l: And-we-too, when you-sent-us from-Jerusalem, reached on day-of Sabbath, and-returned to-you on-today-on-day-of Wednesday;
sentences.i: And as for us, when you sent us from Jerusalem, we arrived on the Sabbath and came back to you today, on Wednesday;
sentences.n: ወለነኒ 'and as for us, too' (ለ- + ነ + ኒ). ሶበ ፈነውከነ 'when you sent us' (ፈነወ 'send', with -ከ 'you', -ነ 'us'). እምኢየሩሳሌም 'from Jerusalem'. በጻሕነ 'we arrived'. በዕለተ ሰንበት 'on the day-of Sabbath'. ዮምበዕለተ ራብዕ: the printed text runs ዮም 'today' and በዕለተ 'on the day-of' together without a wordspace; kept as printed. ራብዕ 'fourth' = Wednesday.

sentences.t: ኀሊኬ ፡ በጥበብ ፡ መጠነ ፡ ይበጽሑ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ሰብእ ።
sentences.l: Consider then with-wisdom how-far would-reach those men.
sentences.i: Reckon, then, with wisdom how far those men can have gone.
sentences.n: ኀሊኬ is the printed form: ኀሊ 'consider' (imperative, as in unit 22) + the particle ኬ 'then, now', which is an unusual spelling of what is meant (the stray form is kept as printed). በጥበብ 'with wisdom'. መጠነ 'how far, to what extent'. ይበጽሑ 'they would reach' (subjunctive/imperfect).

sentences.t: ወተምዐ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ አኀዝዎሙ ፡ ኀምስቲሆሙ ፡ እስከ ፡ ንረክብ ፡ ጽድቀ ፡ ቃሎሙ ፨
sentences.l: And-was-angry king, and-said: Seize-them, their-five (?), until we-find truth-of their-word *
sentences.i: The king was angry, and said, 'Seize them, the five of them (?), until we find the truth of their words.'
sentences.n: ተምዐ 'was angry'. አኀዝዎሙ 'seize them' (imperative plural of አኀዘ). ኀምስቲሆሙ is UNCERTAIN: 'the five of them' (ኀምስት 'five' + ሆሙ), the men who had reported (?). እስከ ንረክብ 'until we find' (እስከ + imperfect). ጽድቀ ቃሎሙ 'truth-of their word' (construct, ቃል with -ሙ). The unit ends with a single ፨, not at a chapter end.

sentences.t: ወአፍጠኑ ፡ ሐዊረ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወሰራዊቱ ፡ ወበጽሑ ፡ ጋዛ ፡ ወተስእሎሙ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ማእዜ ፡ ኀለፈ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ እምኔክሙ ።
sentences.l: And-hastened to-go king and-his-army, and-reached Gaza, and-asked them and-said-to-them: When passed my-son from-you?
sentences.i: The king and his army hastened on, and reached Gaza; and he questioned them and said to them, 'When did my son pass by you?'
sentences.n: ወአፍጠኑ ሐዊረ 'and they hastened to go' (አፍጠነ + infinitive ሐዊረ). ሰራዊቱ 'his army' (ሰራዊት). ጋዛ Gaza. ወተስእሎሙ 'and he asked them' (singular verb after a plural subject-phrase; ተስእለ 'ask'). ወልድየ 'my son' (-የ 'my').

sentences.t: አውሥኡ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ኀለፈ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ሠሉስ ፡ ዕለት ፤
sentences.l: They-answered and-said: He-passed that Tuesday;
sentences.i: They answered and said, 'He passed on that Tuesday;
sentences.n: አውሥኡ 'they answered' (አውሥአ). ይእቲ is the feminine 'that', agreeing with ዕለት 'day'; ሠሉስ ዕለት 'the third day' = Tuesday, as in unit 22. The form of the singular verb ኀለፈ 'he passed' refers to Menelik, 'my son'.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ጸዐኑ ፡ ሰረገላቲሆሙ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘየሐውር ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ምድር ፡ አላ ፡ በሰረገላ ፡ ስቁላን ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ነፉስ ፡ ወይቀልሉ ፡ እምነ ፡ አንስርት ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ንዋዮሙ ፡ የሐውር ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ነፉስ ፡ በሰረገላ ፤
sentences.l: And-when they-loaded their-chariots, there-is-not who goes upon earth, but in-chariots suspended above wind, and-they-are-swift than eagles which-in sky, and-all their-goods goes with-them above wind in-chariot;
sentences.i: and when they had mounted their chariots, none of them went upon the ground, but in chariots hanging above the wind, swifter than the eagles that are in the sky, and all their goods travel with them above the wind in the chariot.
sentences.n: Unit of 24 words. ጸዐኑ 'they mounted / loaded'. አልቦ ዘየሐውር 'there is none who walks'. አላ 'but'. ስቁላን 'hanging, suspended' (plural of ስቁል). ነፉስ is printed here (and again below), but ነፋስ in the next unit; both are 'wind' (the u-spelling is a variant). ዘውስተ ሰማይ 'which (is) in the sky'. ንዋዮሙ 'their goods' (ንዋይ 'goods, belongings' + ሙ). የሐውር 'goes' with a plural subject ('all'), agreeing with ኵሉ.

sentences.t: ወለነሰ ፡ መሰለነ ፡ ዘአንተ ፡ ረሰይከ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ በጥበብከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሖሩ ፡ በሰረገላ ፡ መልዕልተ ፡ ነፋስ ።
sentences.l: And-as-for-us, it-seemed-to-us what you made for-them by-your-wisdom, that-they-go in-chariot above wind.
sentences.i: And to us it seemed to be your own doing, a thing you had made for them by your wisdom, that they travel in a chariot above the wind.
sentences.n: ወለነሰ 'and as for us' (ለ- + ነ + ሰ). መሰለነ 'it seemed to us' (መሰለ 'resemble, seem' + -ነ). ዘአንተ ረሰይከ ሎሙ 'what you yourself made for them' (ረሰየ 'make, set, appoint'; the -ከ is 'you'). በጥበብከ 'by your wisdom'. ከመ ይሖሩ 'that they go'. This is the Egyptians' flattering explanation: they suppose the king himself had provided the flying chariot.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ቦኑ ፡ ዘሀለወት ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ምስሌሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-said-to-them: Is-there, who was, Zion, ark-of the-law of-God, with-them?
sentences.i: And he said to them, 'Was Zion, the Ark of the Law of God, with them?'
sentences.n: ቦኑ 'is there (any)?' (ቦ + the question particle ኑ), 'was there … with them?'. ዘሀለወት ጽዮን 'who was, Zion' (ዘ- agreeing in the feminine, ሀለወት). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'ark-of his law, of God' in apposition. ምስሌሆሙ 'with them'.

sentences.t: ወይቤልዎ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘርኢነ ፨
sentences.l: And-they-said-to-him: Not-is what we-saw. *
sentences.i: And they said to him, 'We saw nothing.'
sentences.n: ወይቤልዎ 'and they said to him' (-ዎ 'him', the singular after -ሎ). አልቦ ዘርኢነ 'there is not what we saw' = 'there is nothing that we saw' (ዘ- relative + ርኢነ 'we saw'). The single ፨ is printed at the end of the chapter and kept on this unit.
